module.title: MUDPACK 5.0.1 multigrid elliptic PDE solvers
entrypoints: test/t*.f drivers, one per solver: mud2/mud3 (real), cud2/cud3 (complex), muh2/muh3 and cuh2/cuh3 (hybrid), 2nd and 4th order (mud24 etc.), cr, sp and sa variants
module.expensive_path: multigrid V and W cycles: line and point Gauss-Seidel relaxation, restriction and prolongation over the grid hierarchy (mudcom.f) on 2D and 3D grids; the OpenMP directives target these loops
module.rationale: The whole library is one module: one build (make, one static library), one test set, one scientific responsibility. MUDPACK 5.0.1 (Adams, NCAR) solves separable and nonseparable linear elliptic PDEs in 2D and 3D by multigrid iteration: real and complex, second- and fourth-order, with hybrid multigrid/direct variants, cross-derivative, separable and self-adjoint forms, and OpenMP directives on the relaxation loops. It is vendored from the NCAR-Classic-Libraries-for-Geophysics container repository as its own codebase because the container holds five unrelated libraries that share no source; this one is packaged alone.
hazards: OpenMP is opt-in (-fopenmp); a threaded build may change reduction order
single precision by default; tcud3cr fails to converge in single precision, so the double-precision build is the reference
Fortran 90 extensions in a Fortran 77 body

approval.human_ref: single-module default: the whole codebase is one module; no human decision at STOP 1, the cut is read in the source PR body at STOP 2
